exposure: HRN screening status (screened negative, screened positive, or not screened)
outcome: linkage to ongoing care after pregnancy (a completed non-urgent visit >6 weeks through 1 year postpartum)
cohort: The study included 4,941 individuals with prenatal care and delivery between 2018-2021 at an urban safety-net hospital.
finding: Screening positive for health-related social needs was not associated with linkage to ongoing care, but being unscreened was associated with a 20% lower likelihood of linkage to ongoing care compared to screening negative.
